notes: Four full-resolution photographs cover both active sides, oblique negative relief and planted feet.
Zero production assets is immutable; hidden contact surfaces are bounded procedural inference.
Portrait-level identity and scan-grade micro-surface are not supported by the available views.

calibration.source: Phase 5 evidence-artifact intervals; implementation and local render time included, deployment/user wait excluded; token telemetry unavailable

features.description: Six alternating reliefs in exact physical order, active side and whole-body facing.
features.supportReason: Count, sequence and both active sides are visible across all four references and enforced structurally.

features.description: One receding folded casting with matched spacing, overlap, height rhythm and outer contour.
features.supportReason: The group contour is clear, but exact camera calibration and hidden overlap depths remain inferred.

features.description: Six role-specific torso, bust, arm and cloth-relief silhouettes.
features.supportReason: Major contours are visible; exact anatomy, hands and hidden joins are not sufficiently resolved for level 4.

features.description: One integrated high-attached pregnancy with the photographed rounded lower contour.
features.supportReason: Front and oblique contours support the major profile, not exact hidden attachment anatomy.

features.description: Six active face directions with role-specific head contour, brow, eyes, nose and mouth relief.
features.supportReason: The references support worn landmark placement and facing, but not high-fidelity portrait identity for all six heads.

features.description: Bare heads, caps and one/two integrated crown rolls in the photographed roles.
features.supportReason: Crown count and silhouette are visible; fine hair surface and hidden profiles are not.

features.description: One broad wrapped newborn loft with unequal ends seated on a visible shallow U-shaped support.
features.supportReason: The swaddle silhouette and support are clear; no infant face or limbs are visible to support invented fine anatomy.

features.description: Two cast tubes buried into the collar, seated just proud of the chest and ending in a low shallow U terminal plus a higher solid circular chestpiece.
features.supportReason: The full path is visible and explicit geometry can support further high-fidelity refinement.

features.description: One separate shallow rectangular hospital badge in the correct role and position.
features.supportReason: The badge silhouette and placement are visible; its eroded surface could be refined further.

features.description: One closed planted foot per relief, with a compact buried root, visible instep, broad forefoot and grounded blunt tapered toe.
features.supportReason: Several feet expose root, instep and toe contour; hidden plantar surfaces and toe anatomy are unresolved by design.

features.description: Closed blank convex head backs, explicit recessed cowl backings and shallow full-height inactive body sheets with thick rims and no read-through.
features.supportReason: Oblique and reverse views expose closure and rim depth, with some hidden interior depth inferred.

features.description: Hand-worked broad undulation, weathering modulation and local asymmetry.
features.supportReason: Photographs reveal broad hand-worked texture, but zero assets and sparse lighting cannot support scan-grade microstructure.

features.description: Near-black weathered bronze with narrow grey wash and readable full-orbit lighting.
features.supportReason: Material range is visible in all references; exact exposure and environment remain camera-dependent.

features.description: Matched detail diagnostics plus uncropped desktop and mobile delivery framing.
features.supportReason: All camera parameters are explicit and framebuffer-tested at their declared viewports.

thresholds.label: Phase 5 major-landmark and contour
thresholds.definition: Verified assembly structure with every critical visible form at least reference-faithful at the major-landmark boundary; scan-grade surface detail remains outside this phase.

thresholds.label: 80% reference-faithful
thresholds.definition: Exact structure, silhouette and delivery cameras with all other features at least reference-faithful.

thresholds.label: 90% high-fidelity
thresholds.definition: High-fidelity critical identity, anatomy and semantic geometry across accepted views.
